description: This file defines the internal class SiloProviderRuntime which implements IProviderRuntime. It manages grain context access and extension binding within the Orleans runtime, specifically for silo provider runtime functionality.

classes.name: SiloProviderRuntime
classes.description: Implements IProviderRuntime, manages grain context and extension binding for silo providers.

methods.name: SiloProviderRuntime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the runtime with grain context accessor, grain factory, and service provider.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds or retrieves an extension of specified type and interface within the grain context.
